email_body:
Dear Payflip team,

I'm applying for the Content Marketeer role. Your mission to become Belgium's salary super app and the trusted source for HR managers and CFOs resonates with me. I build content systems that combine SEO, AI and web development to drive measurable growth.

In my current freelance and agency work, I've built websites and content strategies for B2B and e-commerce clients. I use AI daily to automate research, content creation and audits, and I've developed workflows that multiply output while maintaining quality. For example, I implemented structured data and GEO optimizations that improved search visibility for a Belgian youth chess champion's site. I also manage CMS content and SEO for client sites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Analytics.

I'm eager to bring my technical background and content skills to Payflip's marketing team, helping to build an AI content system that converts and arms sales. I'm fluent in English and have working proficiency in Dutch.

Looking forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Payflip team,

I'm excited to apply for the Content Marketeer position at Payflip. Your ambition to become Belgium's salary super app and the go-to resource for HR managers and CFOs on salary, benefits and payroll aligns perfectly with my skills and interests. I'm particularly drawn to the challenge of building an AI content system that produces high-quality, converting content at scale.

In my freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've gained hands-on experience in SEO, content creation and web development. I've built and optimized websites for various clients, from a Belgian youth chess champion to e-commerce stores, using WordPress, Elementor and Shopify. I've implemented technical SEO and GEO strategies, including structured data and llms.txt, to improve search visibility. I use AI tools daily to automate research, content generation and audits, and I've developed workflows that increase output without sacrificing quality. For instance, I've used LLMs to draft and refine content, and I've built Python scripts to automate repetitive tasks. I'm comfortable judging AI output for accuracy and tone, which is crucial when dealing with sensitive topics like salaries.

I have a strong track record of producing content that converts. I've written SEO blog posts and landing pages, managed CMS content, and tracked performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. I understand the importance of the hook, the offer and the call to action, and I use data to iterate and improve. I'm also multi-format: I've created short videos, carousels and simple calculators using AI tools and templates, always keeping brand consistency in mind.

I thrive on ownership and results. In my freelance projects, I've taken initiative to propose and implement improvements based on data. I'm reliable, team-minded and eager to learn. I'm fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I'm committed to improving further.

I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to Payflip's mission and to grow with your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
